content.comment_body: Hello, I need assistance with wiring a pressure transmitter that outputs 0-10V to a [product_name] 24V device. Inputs 7 and 8 on this module can be set as analog inputs. The transmitter has two contacts labeled L+ and L-, while the module’s input expects a single contact. Is it correct to connect only L+? Thank you everyone. [user_name]

Connect the positive terminal of the sensor output to input I7 of the [product_name], and the negative terminal to the negative 24V DC power supply (M) for the module. I7 will act as analog input AI1 in the program. If you can share the manufacturer and sensor model, more specific help can be provided.
Thank you! The sensor is IFM PN3004; the wiring diagram is attached.
Pin 1 (BN): Connect to 24V+ from the power supply for the module. Pin 2 (WH): Connect to I7 on the module. Pin 4 (BU): Connect to 24V- from the power supply for the module.
Thank you very much, [user_name]. Should pin 3 be connected as well?
Pin 4 (BK) is a digital output. You can use it if necessary, but it's not required for this wiring.
